title: Channel Agencies Director
description:
Overview

Nosso time de Channel Agencies

A Nuvemshop é a principal plataforma de e-commerce da América Latina, com o propósito de potencializar o sucesso de empreendedores e marcas em todos os estágios de crescimento. Nosso ecossistema conta com mais de 2.000 parceiros especialistas , que oferecem serviços de design, marketing, tecnologia e performance para ajudar lojistas a crescerem seus negócios.

Nosso ecossistema de agências parceiras especializadas é um dos principais pilares de aquisição, ativação e sucesso dos nossos clientes — contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento sustentável do negócio e para a consolidação da marca Nuvemshop como a plataforma preferencial do mercado.

A área de Channel Agencies é responsável por desenvolver, gerir e potencializar o desempenho dessas agências, que representam um canal estratégico de receita e diferenciação competitiva. Buscamos um(a) Diretor(a) de Channel Agencies com visão estratégica, profundidade de negócios e forte capacidade de liderança para acelerar o impacto e a maturidade do canal no Brasil.

O tamanho do seu desafio

Channel Agencies é o canal de aquisição de parceiros e merchants, com maior investimento e crescimento nos próximos anos. O(a) Diretor(a) de Channel Agencies deve definir e liderar a estratégia de crescimento, excelência e rentabilidade do canal de agências da Nuvemshop, maximizando o valor entregue aos clientes, a performance das agências parceiras e o retorno financeiro à companhia.

Essa Posição Tem Responsabilidade Direta Sobre o P&L Do Canal De Agências, e Liderança / Influência Transversal Sobre Áreas Como Marketing, Growth, Product, Revenue Excellence e Operations, Atuando Como Guardião Da Estratégia Integrada Entre Produto, Go-to-market e Geração De Demanda.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e desenvolver as estruturas de Channel Agencies, tanto de clientes e agências SMB, como Mid-market, garantindo coesão estratégica, eficiência operacional e excelência na gestão de portfólio de agências;
  • Ser responsável pelo P&L do canal, assegurando crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e previsibilidade de resultados;
  • Orquestrar a visão de produto e experiência do parceiro, em alinhamento com Revenue Excellence e Product, assegurando que o roadmap reflita as necessidades estratégicas das agências e de seus clientes;
  • Supervisionar a área de Demand Generation for Partners, responsável por co-marketing, campanhas integradas e eventos de engajamento, impulsionando geração de leads tanto para agências quanto para a Nuvemshop;
  • Liderar o marketplace de agências, otimizando a conexão entre merchants e parceiros certificados e garantindo excelência em toda a jornada — da descoberta à conversão e retenção;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Marketing, Product Marketing e Customer Success para coordenar a jornada do cliente dentro da plataforma, promovendo uma transição fluida e de alto impacto entre a Nuvemshop e as agências;
  • Construir e sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com lideranças de agências, posicionando a Nuvemshop como a principal plataforma de negócios para seus clientes;
  • Influenciar e alinhar equipes de marketing, eventos, operações e program management, assegurando consistência e execução integrada de todas as frentes relacionadas ao canal;
  • Evoluir o playbook de Channel Agencies, definindo frameworks de crescimento, sucesso e engajamento baseados em benchmarks (Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, RD Station), mas com a cultura e DNA Nuvemshop;
  • Ser o principal porta-voz da estratégia de agências internamente, traduzindo insights de mercado, comportamento dos parceiros e tendências emergentes em decisões de negócio e roadmap.

O que buscamos

  • Sólida experiência em liderança executiva, idealmente em programas de canais e agências em empresas SaaS, plataformas digitais ou de tecnologia;
  • Histórico comprovado de gestão de P&L, crescimento de receita e estruturação de operações escaláveis de parceiros;
  • Visão estratégica ampla, com forte capacidade de integração entre negócios, produto e marketing, traduzindo objetivos corporativos em planos táticos de alto impacto;
  • Perfil de liderança inspiradora, capaz de engajar e alinhar times multifuncionais sob uma visão unificada de crescimento;
  • Elevada capacidade analítica e domínio de gestão por dados e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência comprovada em negociação e relacionamento em nível executivo, com parceiros estratégicos e stakeholders internos;
  • Fluência em inglês.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento profundo do mercado de agências digitais e de performance;
  • Vivência em gestão de programa de parceiros;
  • Histórico de transformação de programas de parceria em motores de crescimento previsível e escalável.

Nosso processo

Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o time de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.

O que temos para você

  • Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash Benefícios: Plataforma que reúne vale alimentação, vale refeição e outras categorias como educação, entretenimento, cultura, saúde, bem-estar, auxílio home office e muito mais;
  • Aulas de espanhol semanais gratuitas;
  • Totalpass: As melhores redes de parcerias para atividades físicas, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e qualidade do sono, com diversos planos disponíveis;
  • Descontos nos cursos da Coderhouse;
  • Auxílio creche para crianças de até 5 anos;
  • Licença de família estendida para 21 dias corridos para pessoas não grávidas ou adotantes. A licença maternidade é de 4 meses e a licença parental de 21 dias. O benefício também vale para famílias que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos;
  • Além das férias, temos uma semana de descanso para recarregar as energias no final/começo do ano;
  • Uma Nuvemshop gratuita para você ou pessoa próxima;
  • Somos #remotefirst - o que significa que damos prioridade ao trabalho remoto dentro do país de contratação, sempre que a função permitir;
  • E um ambiente de desafio contínuo, propósito e protagonismo — aqui você é livre para pensar grande e ter atitude gigante.

Política de Privacidade de Dados

A Nuvemshop está comprometida em proteger a privacidade e garantir a segurança dos dados pessoais das pessoas candidatas às vagas que ofertamos.

Para dar seguimento com a sua candidatura, teremos acesso a alguns dados pessoais seus e gostaríamos de repassar algumas informações antes de você continuar. Utilizaremos tais dados para conduzirmos os processos que envolvem o recrutamento e a seleção. Além disso, cuidamos dos seus dados pessoais de forma muito séria e só os compartilhamos com quem realmente precisa. Por fim, somente iremos mantê-los em nosso sistema pelo tempo realmente necessário.

Para saber mais sobre a forma pela qual tratamos seus dados, inclusive dos seus direitos previstos em lei, basta acessar a nossa Política de Privacidade.

title: Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

Join to apply for the Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer role at Microsoft .

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft.

Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you. We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond‑level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest‑growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always‑up‑to‑date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large‑scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well‑tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on‑call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation‑only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience in an object‑oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well‑tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self‑motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

title: PESSOA COORDENADOR (A) DE CENTRO CIRÚRGICO OFTALMOLÓGICO  -OFTALMOCASA - BARRA DA TIJUCA - RJ (PJ)
description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores. Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como COORDENADOR(A) DE CENTRO CIRÚRGICO OFTALMOLÓGICO que seja proativo, assíduo, pontual e gosta de trabalhar em equipe.

Responsibilities

  • Representar a Enfermagem do hospital junto aos Órgãos Legais de competência do Exercício da Enfermagem;
  • Assumir oficialmente a responsabilidade técnica do serviço de enfermagem cumprindo as exigências legais dos órgãos;
  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar a hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, Comissão Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes (CIPA), Comissão de Controle de Infecções Hospitalares (CCIH), Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Identificar os fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem, e proporcionar resoluções efetivas para cada caso;
  • Coletar os dados dos indicadores preconizados pela equipe de enfermagem e oferecer a Gerente de Enfermagem;
  • Prover recursos materiais e equipamentos necessários para garantir uma assistência qualificada e personalizada aos pacientes cirúrgicos, assegurando à confiança a equipe médica quanto ao êxito do procedimento;
  • Manter atualizado o inventário do instrumental cirúrgico, dos artigos e dos equipamentos;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar do paciente e da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Organizar um sistema eficaz de agendamento prévio das cirurgias eletivas, que possibilite o planejamento de preparação de salas, equipamentos e materiais;
  • Sistematizar e organizar o processo operacional de preparação de salas para os procedimentos cirúrgicos, observando rigorosamente os princípios de assepsia;
  • Efetuar o registro de todas as cirurgias realizadas, mantendo-os sempre atualizados para levantamento dos indicadores ou designar aos enfermeiros plantonistas o registro no livro da Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA);
  • Realizar conferência dos materiais utilizados, e a cobrança dos mesmos nas contas dos pacientes, debitando criteriosamente todo o consumo;
  • Atender as necessidades da sua equipe de enfermagem, orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Elaborar e revisar (anualmente ou sempre que necessário) os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) referentes às rotinas do setor, em conjunto com a gerência de enfermagem;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP);
  • Certificar o correto preenchimento do impresso SAEP, do prontuário, da pulseira de identificação e exames pertinentes ao ato cirúrgico;
  • Garantir a implantação das normativas do Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP);
  • Identificar as não conformidades e a abertura das Notificações do NSP, traçando medidas corretivas no setor;
  • Orientar e supervisionar a equipe de enfermagem quanto aos cuidados com a limpeza e desinfecção dos equipamentos;
  • Fazer a leitura dos indicadores biológicos, de acordo com as rotinas da instituição;
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com sua equipe, visando estabelecer planos únicos de ação;
  • Controlar e supervisionar envios de peças anatomopatológicas para os laboratórios;
  • Participar do processo de seleção da equipe de enfermagem para o CC, realizando entrevistas;
  • Realizar mensalmente a conferência do ponto, controlando a assiduidade, pontualidade e disciplina de seus funcionários, definindo aqueles que receberão folga prêmio, advertências e suspensões;
  • Comunicar ao Departamento Pessoal (DP), nome dos funcionários que receberão advertências e suspensões;
  • Fazer escala mensal de férias e folgas, incluindo o controle da folga prêmio, para o pessoal de enfermagem do seu setor, estabelecendo estratégias de cobertura, autorizações de trocas e plantões extras.

Qualifications

  • Superior Completo em Enfermagem
  • Desejável experiência de 06 meses na função
  • Experiência em OFTALMOLOGIA;
  • Pacote Office (informática)
  • COREN ATIVO

Benefits

  • Refeição no Local;
  • Salário a combinar

Work hours

  • Jornada 40hrs semanais (Segunda a Sexta - feira)

About The Role

The Account Director is accountable for ensuring every customer achieves measurable growth every quarter.

You own outcomes — not activity. You drive real results that customers care about: increased traffic, improved search and AI visibility, stronger conversions, and tangible pipeline impact.

You’ll lead a team of Strategists and Editors, ensuring they deliver consistent excellence without needing you in every conversation. You’ll set the playbook, remove blockers, develop talent, and intervene only when your experience is needed most.

You’ll stay closely involved with our most strategic customers, using your judgment to know when to step in and when to let your team lead. Ultimately, you own the numbers: retention, quality, growth, and customer success.

Who You Are

  • Outcome-Driven Leader: You’ve personally driven measurable growth — traffic, rankings, conversions — and know what actually works.
  • Strategic Operator: You can zoom out to define the strategy and zoom in when high-stakes execution demands your attention.
  • Systems Thinker: You turn insights into playbooks that scale across accounts and teams.
  • Talent Developer: You build teams that think strategically and connect every action to customer outcomes.
  • Decisive and Pragmatic: You act quickly on what matters and avoid unnecessary complexity or process theater.
  • Accountable: You own results. When retention or performance dips, you take responsibility — and fix it fast.

  • Can confidently quarterback across internal teams (product, engineering, design) to advocate for your clients while protecting internal bandwidth.
  • Are highly organized, detail-driven, and great at managing competing priorities.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments and love building from scratch.
  • Are intellectually curious, and have heavily experimented with or implemented AI and automation tools in your daily work.
  • Can do the work yourself. We don’t want someone who points at other people to get things done.

What you’ll do

  • Drive Customer Outcomes
    • Ensure every account has a clear, measurable growth plan.
    • Review performance metrics (traffic, rankings, AI visibility, conversions) regularly.
    • Double down on winning strategies and cut losing efforts quickly.
    • Translate performance into business impact and communicate that story to customers.
    • Step in to course-correct when accounts fall short of growth targets.
  • Lead and Develop the Team
    • Build and coach a high-performing team that connects work to business outcomes.
    • Teach strategic thinking — not just task execution.
    • Remove barriers before they become emergencies.
    • Identify and address performance or fit issues decisively.
    • Create a culture of accountability, learning, and customer obsession.
  • Own the Systems and Playbooks
    • Build playbooks around what actually drives results — not theory.
    • Identify performance patterns across accounts to replicate success.
    • Design frameworks for opportunity identification and prioritization.
    • Implement scalable systems to maintain quality as the organization grows.
  • Manage the Portfolio Strategically
    • Oversee the full customer portfolio with attention to risk, retention, and expansion.
    • Maintain high Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).
    • Identify expansion opportunities through proven performance gains.
    • Ensure consistent delivery standards across all accounts and functions.
  • Lead Strategic Accounts
    • Partner directly with executive stakeholders at key accounts.
    • Participate in MBRs/QBRs and renewal or expansion conversations.

    • Stay involved in critical accounts where stakes and visibility are highest.

Senior Information Security Engineer (GRC)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About The Role
As an Information Security Engineer focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) at Clutch, you will own and mature our trust foundation. You will operationalize our security controls, drive evidence collection and continuous monitoring, and partner with product, engineering, and business teams to reduce risk while enabling speed.

About The Team
You will join a small, high‑impact Security team that partners closely with Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, and GTM. We value outcome‑oriented builders, clear documentation, and automation over manual audits. We work in the open, do frequent retros, and iterate quickly to support a rapidly scaling fintech SaaS platform serving credit unions and their members.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Baseline our control library mapped to SOC 2, PCI DSS, and key fintech obligations. Stand up gaps and remediation owners in our ticketing system.
  • Implement lightweight evidence collection pipelines for top controls such as access reviews, backup tests, vulnerability management, and CI/CD change management.
  • Complete a security risk register refresh with likelihood and impact ratings, and publish a quarterly risk report.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Lead our next SOC 2 Type II audit cycle end‑to‑end, including auditor coordination, population requests, and walkthroughs.
  • Roll out a vendor risk management workflow integrated with procurement and Legal, including tiering, due diligence, and continuous monitoring.
  • Partner with Engineering to define secure SDLC checkpoints and automate evidence from GitHub, CI, and cloud.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Drive PCI DSS certification readiness, including SoA ownership, internal audits, and management review inputs.
  • Establish KPI/KRIs and dashboards for control effectiveness and risk trends consumed by execs and customers.
  • Mature incident response playbooks and conduct at least one cross‑functional tabletop with measurable improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in GRC, security engineering, or risk management within SaaS or fintech environments.
  • Proven experience running SOC 2 Type II and working toward ISO 27001, including evidence automation and auditor interactions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security controls across AWS, containerized workloads, and modern CI/CD.
  • Practical knowledge of secure SDLC, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and third‑party risk.
  • Ability to translate requirements into actionable, ticketed work with clear owners and due dates.
  • Excellent written communication for policies, customer questionnaires, and exec‑level reporting.
  • Nice to have: experience with privacy programs, PCI readiness, or financial services regulations; relevant certs (e.g., CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 LI/LA) are a plus.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere.
  • Unforgettable Off‑Sights: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: 20 PTO days yearly and national holidays.
  • Stock Options: Receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Budget for work-related trips and co‑working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aiming to revolutionize the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. We develop software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and help them responsibly lend to over 130M Americans.

Contractor Position

This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

description:
Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

Join to apply for the Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer role at Microsoft

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from home. The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft. Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you!

We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond-level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up-to-date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high-scale, low-latency, always-on, and cost-effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large-scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well-tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in an object-oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well-tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

Olá! Eu sou um banco digital, mas pode me chamar de Will!

Estou muito feliz por ter você aqui e que queria me apresentar um pouco mais. Eu sou a segunda maior instituição de pagamentos do Brasil!

Nasci com um propósito muito claro: democratizar o mundo financeiro e mostrar que crédito é um voto de confiança que todos e todas merecem, e podem ter.

Quando o assunto é “ fazer a diferença real na vida de todas as pessoas”, pode apostar que não vai faltar esforço.

As pessoas que trabalham comigo são os Willers e já somos mais de 1300 pessoas espalhadas pelos quatro cantos do Brasil, somos +44% de pessoas que se autodeclaram pessoas não brancas e 51% são mulheres. Eu quero ser tão diverso como o Brasil, sei que é desafiador, mas eu não tô nessa sozinho, tem um monte de gente me ajudando a chegar lá.

Você quer fazer parte disso? Olha que o time de Communications Platforms faz!

Você vai desenvolver as soluções que possibilitam a comunicação do Will com toda a nossa base de clientes. Somos o time responsável pela plataforma de comunicação da empresa ou seja, praticamente toda conversa com o cliente passa por aqui.

Quais serão os seus desafios:

  • Projetar e implementar soluções customizadas nas nuvens de Salesforce;
  • Projetar e implementar integrações eficazes entre o Salesforce e outros sistemas empresariais;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para definir requisitos, cronogramas e prioridades de entrega;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e manutenção contínua para as soluções implantadas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Domínio de Node.js, Go ou Python é necessário ter profundidade em pelo menos uma dessas linguagens e interesse em aprender as outras;
  • Experiência na criação e orquestração de microserviços;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, como PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis e SQL Server;
  • Adoção de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, como Clean Code e testes automatizados;
  • Conhecimentos em segurança de aplicações, incluindo protocolos como OAuth e JWT;
  • Capacidade de realizar análise e otimização de performance de aplicações;
  • Vivência com ambientes em Cloud (AWS);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, incluindo Design Patterns (creational, estruturais e comportamentais) e princípios SOLID;
  • Conhecimento em IaC;
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Conhecimento do ecossistema da Salesforce;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestradores, como Docker, Amazon ECS e Kubernetes.

Gostou? Isso porque você ainda não viu os benefícios de ser um willer:

Cartão Flash para seus gastos flexíveis: Com valores compatíveis com o mercado, destinados a Vale Alimentação/Refeição, home office, parte totalmente flexível para uso em aplicativos de mobilidade, farmácias, cultura, educação, alimentação e refeição.

Saúde de qualidade com a Amil: Tenha acesso a uma rede de saúde e odontológica nacional de primeira linha, além de descontos em farmácias. Plano de cobertura nacional.

Auxílios que fazem a diferença: Oferecemos seguro de vida, auxílio creche e auxílio para dependentes com deficiência.

Queremos o seu crescimento: Oferecemos descontos em instituições de ensino e escolas de inglês. Além disso, temos programas de desenvolvimento interno para lideranças e subsídios para impulsionar o conhecimento dos willers.

Bem-estar é prioridade: Cuide da sua saúde mental e física com as parcerias que temos. Acesse serviços profissionais de psicologia com o C4life e Psicologia Viva, e tenha acesso a academias e aulas online através do Wellhub e Totalpass.

Programa Distribuwill: Faça parte do nosso Programa de Participação nos Resultados, o Distribuwill!

Inclusão e diversidade: Oferecemos reembolso para a retificação de nomes para pessoas trans, e acreditamos em uma licença parental de 180 dias para um cuidado igualitário em todas as configurações familiares.

Day off de aniversário: Um dia para descansar com quem ama e aproveitar a sua data especial.

description:
Sr Director, Client Results

This position will provide leadership and direction for the day to day operations of account(s).

The Purpose of Your Role

The Senior Director of Client Results is responsible for overall operations and operational performance. The Senior Director will be the senior point of contact for day-to-day management of the business; the ability to offer solutions and new ideas to promote program success, revenue growth, and profitability. He/she will be responsible for overseeing the management and coordination of various support functions and activities for accounts. The Senior Client Results Director will direct and supervise the development and execution of performance strategies to maximize results. He / she will work cross-functionally and direct all necessary support initiatives for accounts. Leadership will need to be tactical with a key emphasis on maximizing KPI, customer care, quality assurance, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, and training.

The Qualifications We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of work experience required
  • 10 + years of contact center/BPO experience
  • 6 years prior multi-level management experience
  • Proven demonstrable track record of success
  • Team player able to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills in a team environment
  • Experience with interacting and influencing clients’ outcomes
  • Executive Presence
  • Strong Organizational, multi-tasking, time management skills
  • Travel up to 25% when it’s safe to travel

The Competencies You Bring

External (Strategic) Awareness, P&L Ownership, Dealing with Ambiguity, Organizational Awareness, Business Acumen, Results Orientation

The Value You Deliver

Development and Execution of Strategic Account Plan

  • Responsible for overall success of program(s) and account health
  • Define and manage metrics, ensure customer satisfaction, and report statistical performance levels to appropriate groups
  • Perform senior-level Client negotiation and management skills, with clear and substantive speaking, writing, and presentation skills
  • Develop customer communication strategies
    • Establish and communicate the service standards to the operations team so that quality customer satisfaction is achieved
    • Senior point of contact for senior Client contacts and escalations
  • Develop Trusted Adviser partnerships at the senior-level
  • Account Plans
    • Build relationships at all levels
      • Ensure multi-level coverage
    • Strategize the planning, developing, and directing of the customer service program
    • Direct and supervise initiatives and deliverables in Account Plans
  • Growth and Profitability Strategies
    • Direct analytic, strategic and technical resources to meet client expectations and ensure satisfaction
    • Foster and create business innovation to drive increased performance and adoption
    • Oversee multiple projects at once and ensure strong integration across the organization
    • Ensure Directors and Managers are trained on all aspects of applications and reporting; which will require research tools, as well as excellent writing and presentation skills

Responsible for account P&L

  • Entire book of business and individual accounts
  • Identify additional revenue streams within install base

Promote active agent engagement and advancement

  • Oversee attrition rates, incentives and rewards, Statement of Work adherence, quality, communication
  • Direct performance optimization strategies to further improve agent productivity and performance

Business Calibration

  • Drive cross-functional calibration with support functions and teams, e.g. (Workforce Management, Professional Services, Talent Acquisition and Onboarding)
  • Regular touch points with Clients, Directors, Managers, Agent Results Advocates & Agents
  • Manage up to VP and Leadership
  • Create an effective process and information flow between Client Results Team and Cross Functional Teams
  • Serve as Client Results advocate and liaison for company-wide projects and initiatives

Employee Management

  • Day-to-day supervision of resources, including sourcing, coaching, performance management and employee development
  • Developing bench strength within the team directly and by creating a culture of professional development
  • Responsible for succession planning with Directors and Managers, and oversee succession planning for Agent Results Advocates
  • Foster a productive and empowering work environment at all levels
  • Mentor and develop his/her team and direct them in finding creative solutions for both client and internal challenges, foster knowledge-sharing across all verticals internally to ensure collaborative and informed work
  • Provide team with necessary tools and training to improve core expertise and continued career growth
  • Create an effective process and information flow between Directors and Managers

Budget Support

  • Execute against established annual department budget to attain business goals with operational stability

About Liveops

Liveops is a virtual call center offering an on-demand skilled workforce of onshore virtual agents for all customer service and sales needs.

With more than 20 years of experience offering flexibility, scalable talent and meaningful work, Liveops has been improving the lives of its agents, clients, and employees by creating endless opportunity. Our virtual-flex model has enabled more than 400 organizations across service industries including retail, healthcare, insurance, tax, telecom, and government to trust Liveops to deliver a fully scalable enterprise workforce, with faster program readiness, increased revenue, and greater customer satisfaction scores than traditional call centers.

title: Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft. Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you! We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond-level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up-to-date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high-scale, low-latency, always-on, and cost-effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large-scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well-tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on‑call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience in an object‑oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well‑tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self‑motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist in our Generative AI area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Multimodal Extraction : Apply state-of-the-art tools (OCR, vision-language models, document understanding frameworks) to interpret diverse input types;
  • Prompt Engineering : Develop and refine strategies for using LLMs to extract, summarize, and transform unstructured content into structured formats;
  • Data Quality & Structuring : Clean, validate, and transform messy, unstructured data into well-defined schemas ready for use in training or analytics pipelines;
  • Content Filtering : Define standards and build systems for cleaning, validating, and filtering data to ensure accuracy, reduce bias, and align with ethical/safety guidelines;
  • Human-in-the-Loop Feedback : Design feedback loops where experts validate or enrich data, improving LLM-based extraction reliability;
  • Scalability & Optimization : Architect cost-efficient, high-throughput data pipelines that are robust to noisy or incomplete sources;
  • Research & Prototyping : Experiment with emerging tools and methods in the LLM + multimodal space, exploring new ways to enhance information coverage and extraction reliability;
  • Collaboration : Partner with data engineers and other data scientists to integrate collected data into larger AI and analytics systems;
  • Live the mission : inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Master’s degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field;
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries for web scraping, OCR (e.g., Tesseract, EasyOCR), and NLP (e.g., HuggingFace Transformers);
  • Deep understanding of LLM capabilities in multimodal and extraction contexts, including prompt engineering and few-shot learning;
  • Strong background in unstructured data processing: APIs, web scraping, HTML parsing, OCR, image/document analysis;
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with a track record of turning noisy data into high-quality datasets for ML;
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence across technical and product teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with visual-language models (e.g., BLIP, Donut, or LayoutLM) and multimodal pipelines;
  • Hands-on experience in prompt engineering and few-shot learning for data extraction tasks;
  • Experience deploying or supporting data acquisition systems in production environments.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on ourcareers page!

title: Especialista em infraestrutura
description:
A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Responsabilidades

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial)

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Informações adicionais

  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

Our client is a dynamic digital advertising and marketing automation agency, where a consultative, hands-on approach drives exceptional results. They are experts in digital advertising and CRM, dedicated to improving our clients' return on ad spend. Working across diverse industries, they provide innovative solutions and leverage cutting-edge tools and platforms to help businesses thrive. Be part of a team that's passionate about delivering impactful marketing strategies and achieving measurable success.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled Creative Director to serve as the key creative engine supporting our agency’s diverse marketing and advertising needs. This role is ideal for a hands-on designer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and possesses the technical fluency to create highly effective content optimized for various digital platforms.

You will be responsible for conceptualizing and producing high-quality visual assets that drive engagement and conversion across all client and internal channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content & Asset Production: Paid Media Design – Design and format compelling visual content (static images, basic animations) specifically optimized for placement on major advertising channels, including Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google, and X (Twitter).
  • Short-Form Video: Produce and edit engaging short-form video content for organic and paid placement across platforms like TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Meta Reels.
  • Email Marketing: Design visually appealing and high-converting email templates and graphics for marketing automation campaigns.
  • Design Tool Mastery: Utilize tools like Canva, Figma, and Photoshop with exceptional skill to maintain brand consistency and deliver production-ready creative assets on time.

Web Design & Technical Aptitude

  • Web/Landing Page Design: Create clean, functional, and aesthetically pleasing web and landing page designs (UX/UI planning and mockups), focusing on client conversion goals. Note: Direct web development (coding) is not required, but proficiency in web development is a significant advantage.
  • Creative Optimization (Bonus Skills): Utilize familiarity with principles of SEO and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) to inform design choices, ensuring all produced content is positioned for maximum performance.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a comparable multi-client role, specifically serving the U.S. market.
  • Design Proficiency: Exceptional, proven skills in Canva, Figma, and Adobe Photoshop for both rapid content creation and polished, detailed design work.
  • Platform-Specific Design: Demonstrated understanding of the content specifications and best practices for advertising and organic placement on Meta, Google, and short-form video platforms.
  • Experience in producing and editing engaging short-form video assets.
  • Versatility: Proven ability to manage and switch contexts between high-volume ad creative, detailed email graphics, and web design projects.
  • Communication: Strong ability to take creative direction and translate marketing objectives into effective visual solutions.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience or deep technical knowledge in SEO and/or CRO.
  • Basic to advanced web development (coding) skills.
  • Up-to-date education or professional certifications in design, digital marketing, brand strategy, or digital media production.

description:
Overview

#VemSerMAG

A gestora nasceu em 2013 com o objetivo de administrar os recursos do Grupo MAG, e hoje entregamos soluções em investimentos para diversos clientes, sejam eles institucionais, corporativos ou plataformas digitais. Em cada momento de nossa expansão mantivemos o compromisso com as práticas de governança corporativa, gestão de risco e transparência na política de investimentos, proporcionando confiança e serviços de qualidade. A atuação fundamentada em sólidas estratégias de investimentos e forte relacionamento com os clientes, é a marca da nossa caminhada até aqui.

Desde 2017, reafirmamos a classificação do Rating de Qualidade de Gestão pela Moody’s; em 2022 tivemos a elevação da nossa nota para MQ1 (Excelente) e em 2024 fechamos o ano com, aproximadamente, R$16 bilhões sob gestão. Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, temos mais de 6,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década. Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos um Trader de Multimercado com foco em juros e moeda para fazer parte do time de gestão de fundos da MAG Investimentos. Você deverá discutir cenários de mercado, ideias de trades e fazer a execução e alocação dos ativos.

  • Elaboração das estratégias de investimento nas classes de renda fixa e multimercado e operações dos ativos que compõem as carteiras.
  • Monitoramento dos preços e análise das tendências para apoiar nas operações e estratégias nos mercados de renda fixa, variável e de câmbio.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

  • Graduação completa em engenharia, economia, administração, estatística, matemática ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência prévia em áreas relacionadas a gestão de fundos de investimento;
  • Experiência anterior em asset;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma 100% presencial no Centro do Rio de Janeiro;

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Certificação CGA ou CFA;

Overview

You’ll join an expert annotation team to create training data for the world’s most advanced AI models. No previous AI experience is necessary. Flexible Schedules

  • Developers can set their own hours; the role is best suited for those able to commit to substantial weekly hours and engage with teams, while remaining flexible on working hours.

  • Credentials to the RLHF platform will be provided, followed by a group Q&A about onboarding.
  • You’ll perform a simulated production-level RLHF task. Successful completion provides an opportunity to work on projects as they become available.
  • Current priority is for engineers well-versed in Python.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, OR Bachelor’s in Computer Science / Engineering / STEM with 4+ years of specialized experience
  • Complete fluency in English
  • Ability to articulate complex scientific concepts clearly and engagingly
  • Excellent attention to detail and consistency in writing
  • Solid understanding of grammar, punctuation, and style guidelines
  • Proficiency with Python

Nice To Haves:

  • Recognized accomplishments or contributions to coding communities or projects
  • Proven analytical skills with creative problem-solving
  • Adept communication skills for understanding and discussing project requirements
  • A commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with latest coding practices
  • Enthusiasm for teaching AI models and experience with technical writing

  • Mid-Senior level

title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Overview

Be among the first 25 applicants

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers. We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization. We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

  • You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:
  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Experience deploying ML systems serving 100M+ predictions daily
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES

  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

  • Fazer interface com a equipe de Planejamento Integrado da Afiliada para garantir alinhamento das informações com as premissas do LTP.

Documentação e Relatórios

  • Liderar a Gestão da Informação do exercício de Planejamento de Longo Prazo: estruturar documentação, criar processo para arquivamento sistemático de todos os documentos (apresentações, MoM, hipóteses, cartões de custos, orçamentos).

  • Garantir que os bancos de dados LTP (Shuttle, CFR-Pro, ENV etc.) estejam atualizados e que os prazos definidos pelo HQ para carga de dados sejam cumpridos.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o acompanhamento do Desenvolvimento dos Ativos.
  • Gerar informações técnicas validadas para o exercício de Planejamento de Longo Prazo, principalmente sobre Produção, Capex e Opex.

Perfil do Candidato

  • Formação : Graduação em Engenharia ou equivalente em Petróleo, Mecânica, Produção, Projetos etc.
  • Experiência profissional : Mínimo de 5 anos na indústria de óleo e gás com primeiro contato com perfuração, operações de campo ou projetos durante estágio ou similar.
  • Competências técnicas : Integração de valores HSE, interesse pelo setor de O&G. Excelente domínio de ferramentas de comunicação e banco de dados. Autonomia na organização do trabalho, bem organizado, rigoroso para produzir resultados/informações validadas, sensibilidade à inovação.
  • Competências comportamentais : Boa comunicação, interesse por ambiente multicultural e networking. Capacidade de adaptação e gestão de tarefas diversas em diferentes configurações. Adaptável e flexível sob pressão e prazos curtos.
  • Outras competências : Fluente em inglês.

title: Software Engineer, Android Core Product - Campinas, Brazil
description:
Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Speechify’s text-to-speech products are used by over 50 million people to turn PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, and websites into audio so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Our products include iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google named Speechify Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work at Speechify in a distributed setting with no office. This includes frontend and backend engineers, AI researchers, and others from major tech companies and universities.

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

What You’ll Do

  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team – take ownership of features inside the app and deliver high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams – Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the plan
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User-oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus

  • Experience building, maintaining, or contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit

What We offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech—the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Realizar consultas online para avaliação, diagnóstico e acompanhamento de doenças neurológicas.

title: Coordenadora Administrativa-Financeira Pleno
description:
CANDIDATURA

As pessoas interessadas deverão enviar carta de motivação, compartilhando o seu interesse em trabalhar na Empodera e currículo, ambos em PDF, para ****** , com assunto "Coordenadora Adm-Fin Pleno", até as 23h59 do dia 31/08/2025. As candidaturas que não cumprirem essas especificações serão desconsideradas.

Sobre a posição

A coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno é a responsável, juntamente com a gestão executiva, por analisar, gerenciar e implementar sistemas e processos administrativos e financeiros eficientes e transparentes na organização. Ela coordena e acompanha a equipe da área, elabora orçamentos e relatórios de prestação de contas, controla fluxo de caixa e conciliações bancárias, e desenvolve processos integrados que aumentam a eficiência e a eficácia da organização, num ambiente empreendedor e colaborativo.

Vaga exclusiva para mulheres (cis/trans). A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres negras, indígenas, vivendo com HIV/AIDS, LBTI+ e com deficiência.

Quem somos

Fundada em 2017, a Empodera – Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional, que utiliza o esporte e jogos lúdicos para que meninas adolescentes em situação de vulnerabilidade social exerçam seu pleno potencial e direitos. A organização foca na redução de estereótipos nocivos e violência baseada no gênero e trabalha com desenvolvimento e execução de metodologias esportivas, treinamentos e suporte técnico de organizações em prol de uma sociedade mais justa e equânime.

Responsabilidades Principais

FINANCEIRO – OPERAÇÕES (40%)

  • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa organizacional
  • Supervisionar as operações financeiras diárias – contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber, salários, obrigações fiscais
  • Analisar e apresentar relatórios financeiros de maneira precisa e oportuna; comunicar claramente as demonstrações financeiras mensais e anuais
  • Elaborar relatórios financeiros para prestação de contas e supervisionar a contabilidade financeira, de projetos/programas e doações
  • Fornecer informações financeiras em tempo hábil e preciso
  • Supervisionar e liderar a elaboração do orçamento organizacional anual e planejamento financeiro em conjunto com a diretora executiva; monitorar progresso e mudanças
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias de acordo com o fluxo de pagamento semanal
  • Emitir notas fiscais de acordo com obrigações legais e fiscais

FINANCEIRO – GESTÃO DE PROGRAMAS (20%)

  • Manter comunicação frequente com as coordenadoras de projetos para análise dos gastos (reais x orçados)
  • Apresentar a prestação de contas dos projetos nos prazos estipulados
  • Fornecer relatórios financeiros mensais às coordenadoras de projetos, incluindo gastos por centro de custo/projeto
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de orçamentos para editais
  • Garantir que a organização atenda aos requisitos externos dos doadores
  • Comunicar com parceiros sobre o andamento financeiro dos programas

FINANCEIRO – COMPLIANCE (15%)

  • Atualizar e implementar todas as políticas e procedimentos financeiros necessários
  • Coordenar e liderar eventuais processos de auditoria
  • Supervisionar a produção do relatório financeiro anual
  • Examinar documentos financeiros e legais para garantir aderência aos regulamentos e princípios financeiros
  • Garantir o uso eficaz e transparente dos recursos financeiros em conformidade com políticas internas e de parceiros

RECURSOS HUMANOS E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (15%)

  • Coordenar, acompanhar e colaborar no desenvolvimento da equipe
  • Garantir que folha de pagamento mensal, pagamento de benefícios e manutenção de registros sejam executados de maneira eficiente
  • Garantir a conformidade com a legislação trabalhista local
  • Participar de treinamentos internos e externos sobre temas relacionados à função e aos programas desenvolvidos pela organização

ADMINISTRATIVO – (10%)

  • Coordenar as atividades administrativas da área/equipe
  • Aprimorar e elaborar processos administrativos e políticas internas
  • Supervisionar os processos administrativos, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos adotados pela Empodera
  • Orientar a equipe em relação aos procedimentos administrativos e financeiros

FORMAÇÃO, EXPERIÊNCIA E HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS

  • Formação: Nível superior completo, com preferência para as áreas de ciências contábeis, administração, economia
  • Conhecimentos avançados do pacote Office, especialmente Excel
  • Minimo de 3 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas, financeira, contábeis e de pessoal (fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar e receber, orçamento, conciliação bancária)
  • Experiência comprovada no setor administrativo‑financeiro em organizações da sociedade civil (altamente desejável)
  • Experiência com coordenação de equipes
  • Experiência com prestação de contas para agências das Nações Unidas (desejável)
  • Experiência com elaboração, execução, prestação de contas e auditoria de projetos nacionais e internacionais
  • Experiência com controles internos e bancários
  • Experiência com o sistema financeiro Ongsys ou outro sistema ERP (será diferencial)
  • Habilidades de colaboração, atenção aos detalhes, autonomia, organização, proatividade, bom relacionamento interpessoal e facilidade de trabalhar em equipe
  • Idiomas: Inglês (diferencial)

Contratação

  • Modalidade: CLT, por prazo indeterminado
  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Salário: R$ 7.235,00 (bruto)
  • Benefícios: vale-transporte, vale-refeição ou alimentação, seguro de vida, day-off de aniversário, convênio com o SESC, Zenklub e Total Pass
  • Início: Setembro/25
  • Formato de trabalho: presencial no escritório no centro do Rio de Janeiro – RJ com flexibilidade para remoto (1x na semana)

Vaga

Enviar carta de apresentação, compartilhando o seu interesse e motivação em trabalhar na Empodera, + currículo para ****** , assunto: "VAGA Coordenação administrativa-financeira pleno". Prazo para envio de candidaturas: até 31/08/2025.

title: Software Engineer – Reinventing How the World Rents
description:
Software Engineer – Reinventing How the World Rents

Join to apply for the Software Engineer – Reinventing How the World Rents role at The Flex

Overview

At The Flex, we’re building the digital operating system of the rental world. Our mission is to make renting borderless, instant, and intelligent. Through Base360.ai, we connect property data, automate operations, and create an intelligent infrastructure that powers every stay, everywhere. We’re looking for a Software Engineer who loves building systems that automate the real world — at the crossroads of AI, automation, and scalability.

If you’re driven by impact and engineering elegance, this is your chance to help reinvent how millions live, travel, and rent.

Your Mission

  • Build the Core – Develop scalable, high-performance APIs and automation workflows that drive global operations.
  • Automate Everything – Design microservices and serverless functions that eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
  • Integrate the Ecosystem – Connect Base360.ai with partners like Airbnb, Stripe, and Twilio through clean, reliable integrations.
  • Design for Scale – Build fault-tolerant, event-driven systems that can handle millions of transactions in real time.
  • Collaborate Across Borders – Partner with product, data, and operations teams to bring automation to life in the physical world.
  • Ship Fast, Learn Faster – Iterate quickly, measure impact, and scale what works.

You’re a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience with Node.js, React, and/or Python (FastAPI).
  • Familiarity with AWS (serverless stack) and API-first architectures.
  • Experience with databases, microservices, and real-time systems.
  • A builder’s mindset — fast, pragmatic, and obsessed with elegant solutions.
  • Curiosity about automation, AI, and real estate tech.
  • A bias for action — you move ideas to production, not slide decks.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Massive real-world impact. Your code will power thousands of stays and automate operations across cities worldwide.
  • Global mission, lean team. No bureaucracy — just ambitious builders who move fast.
  • Autonomy & ownership. You’ll have freedom to make decisions and ship bold ideas.
  • Performance-driven rewards. Competitive compensation + upside for top performers.
  • Remote-first culture. Work from anywhere. What matters is output, not hours.

Do Not Apply If

  • You want predictable routines over progress.
  • You prefer planning to building.
  • You’re not aiming to be among the top 1% in your craft.

The Brand Director plays a pivotal role in managing key client relationships, leading internal teams, and driving business growth across multiple accounts. Benefits
